title: Lemon quinoa with peas and carrots
blurb: A light grain bowl with sweet peas and carrots, sharp feta and fresh herbs
steps: Rinse the quinoa in a sieve under cold water, then tip into a saucepan with the vegetable stock and bring to the boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover and simmer for 15 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the quinoa is tender.
Meanwhile, peel and finely chop the onion, then peel and dice the carrot into small cubes.
Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat, add the onion and carrot and cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened.
Drain the peas and add them to the pan, cooking for 2 minutes to warm through.
Zest and juice the lemon, then chop the parsley and crumble the feta.
Fluff the cooked quinoa with a fork, then stir through the vegetables, lemon zest and juice, and most of the parsley.
Divide between two bowls and top with the crumbled feta, remaining parsley and black pepper.
